The replicated value equals the paper value exactly (0 relative error, well within ±1σ), so this is a match. fix_severity.json notes the estimation pipeline was ported Stata->R/fixest (major, environment-driven) but load-checked only; nonetheless the produced headline number reproduces the paper exactly.
